Twi'lek Advisor is listed twice (under Starting and again under Interrupts); dested as posted (2 total).

The posted lines carry the author's comments in parentheses (kept in the posted text). 'Boba Fett In Slave 1' dested Boba Fett In Slave I; the bare 'Tatooine ...', 'Endor ...', 'Executor ...' and 'Jabba's Palace ...' names dested the matching sites.
Battle Order, Resistance, Secret Plans, Oppressive Enforcement and Come Here You Big Coward (where listed) are the pre-Reflections III Effects (no Defensive Shields in 2000).
